target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
which pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "pdflatex present" || echo "NO pdflatex"
for pass in 1 2; do
  pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error defect_cocycle_with_findings.tex >/tmp/dcf_build.log 2>&1
done
echo "exit=$?"
ls -la defect_cocycle_with_findings.pdf 2>/dev/null && echo "PDF OK"
echo "--- warnings/errors (if any) ---"
grep -iE "^!|error|undefined|overfull \\\\hbox \\([0-9]{3}" /tmp/dcf_build.log | head -15 || true
